title: Base ReadRange variant 3 revised
purpose: Reach deeper parser logic with a confirmed ReadRange request that includes object and property selection plus a nested range form carrying a signed start position and item count.

messages.label: BACnet/IP Confirmed ReadRange request with nested range selection

expected_behavior: A BACnet/IP server should parse the message as a confirmed ReadRange request, process the nested range selector, and then return a range result or a protocol-conforming error.
constraints_preserved: BVLC total length 0x001d matches the full encoded message length
BVLC, NPDU, and confirmed APDU layering follow a common BACnet/IP arrangement
Object identifier and property identifier precede nested range data
Nested opening and closing tags are balanced in the range selector
Hex is lowercase and has an even number of characters
issue_safety_notes: No known issue is being targeted. This deeper form is a conservative structural seed based on model prior and should not be treated as externally verified protocol evidence.
